subject.title: refactor(media): introduce neutral MediaFact owner with identity-preserving adapters

question: Should the repository adopt `MediaFact` as the neutral shared owner for the remaining media-facts program while retaining the existing legacy payload projections exactly as tested?
rationale: The implementation is an architecture-level consolidation spanning channels, transcripts, and plugin-facing media adapters; the protected maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision even though no concrete patch defect is established.

options.title: Proceed with the foundation
options.body: Accept the neutral `MediaFact` owner after confirming the adapter tests cover the intended legacy payload and prompt-byte invariants.

options.title: Keep ownership local
options.body: Decline the shared owner and retain existing local media types if the planned follow-up migrations do not justify a cross-surface abstraction.

recommendation.title: Proceed with the foundation
recommendation.body: Accept the neutral `MediaFact` owner after confirming the adapter tests cover the intended legacy payload and prompt-byte invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and this PR's program context make this contributor the clearest available owner for the media-facts design direction.
